title: Version 4.0.0 Changelog
notice: Version 4 rewrites TMA Cloud in Rust: update with `update.sh`, which backs up the database and renames the changed settings in `.env`, and install the new desktop app.

changed.text: Rewrite the server, web app and desktop app in Rust
Report separate server, web and desktop versions from `GET /api/version/latest`, without the `electron` key

changed: Run the API, background worker and admin commands from one `tma-server` binary
Share one interface between the web app and the desktop app
Run Cloud Drive without a driver: Cloud Files on Windows, FUSE on Linux, NFS on macOS
Redesign Settings as grouped sections, with plain wording throughout
Redesign the sign-in and sign-up screens
Redesign the share dialog, and light the Share button for shared items
Rework the file toolbar and the upload dialog
Sort names without regard to case, with numbers by value
Select the folder you came from when going up
Refuse a new or renamed folder whose name is already taken, in any letter case
Split the sub-user trash permission into restore and delete forever; sub-users who could manage the trash keep both
Give each signed-in user 30,000 requests per 15 minutes, and stop counting the event stream
Copy stored objects 24 at a time and delete them in batches of 1,000
Update folder totals and storage use once per statement
Restore backups into a scratch database and swap it in only on success
Send every download as an attachment in a sandbox
Switch the interface font to Figtree
added: Add the desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux, with updates installed in the background
Download Cloud Drive files when opened and upload changes as they are saved
Re-list only the Cloud Drive folders that changed, within half a second
Keep Office and editor backup files on the computer, out of the cloud
Open files in their desktop app on double-click, through Cloud Drive
Copy and paste files and folders between the desktop app and File Explorer on Windows
Keep the desktop sign-in while the server is out of reach
Lock a file while someone edits it in Cloud Drive, a desktop app or ONLYOFFICE
Show who is editing a file, and open it read-only for everyone else
Keep a save made from an outdated copy as a conflicted copy instead of overwriting
Add an About page with versions, links and Copy details for bug reports
Show a revisited folder at once while its fresh listing loads
Jump to items by typing their first letters
Ask before moving items to the trash or into another folder
Check names as you type in New folder and Rename
Zoom and pan in the image viewer
Show who opened each file in Recent files
Show the password while typing it, and let password managers fill the sign-in form
Report which folders changed since a cursor with `GET /api/files/changes`
Cap the memory uploads may buffer across the server with `UPLOAD_MEMORY_MB`
Listen on IPv6 as well as IPv4
removed: Remove the Node, React, Electron and .NET code
fixed: Stop parallel writes from deadlocking by locking the account, then folders in order
Read a refused upload before answering, so apps show the reason instead of a dropped connection
Deliver file events locally while Redis is unreachable
Refuse ONLYOFFICE saves from internal addresses
